source_evidence: Employers such as public educational institutions (public schools, colleges, and universities), certain non-profits, and churches or church-related organizations may offer 403(b) plans. Employers such as state and local government agencies and certain non-profit organizations may offer 457(b) plans.
question: What types of employers may offer 403(b) plans, and what types may offer 457(b) plans?
answer: 403(b) plans may be offered by public educational institutions, certain nonprofits, and churches or church-related organizations. 457(b) plans may be offered by state and local government agencies and certain nonprofits. Some employers may offer both plans.
